must_remember: The mean or average value of a sinusoidal alternating current over a complete cycle is zero, while over a half-cycle it is I_mean = 2I_0 / pi approx 0.637 I_0.
The RMS (virtual) value of sinusoidal AC is given by I_rms = I_0 / sqrt(2) approx 0.707 I_0.

In a pure resistive AC circuit, voltage and current are in phase; in a pure inductive circuit, voltage leads current by pi/2 radians; in a pure capacitive circuit, current leads voltage by pi/2 radians.
Impedance of a series LCR circuit is Z = sqrt(R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2) where X_L = omega L and X_C = 1 / (omega C).
Resonance in a series LCR circuit occurs when X_L = X_C, yielding minimum impedance Z = R and maximum current.
The resonant angular frequency of a series LCR circuit is omega_0 = 1 / sqrt(LC), and the resonant frequency is f_0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(LC)).
The Quality factor (Q-factor) of a series LCR circuit represents the sharpness of resonance and is defined as Q = (omega_0 L) / R = 1 / (omega_0 C R).
The average power dissipated in an AC circuit is P_avg = V_rms * I_rms * cos(phi), where cos(phi) is the power factor equal to R / Z.

glossary.meaning: An electric current that reverses direction periodically, typically sinusoidally in standard applications.
The root-mean-square or virtual value of an alternating quantity, representing its equivalent DC heating effect.
The opposition offered by a pure inductor to the flow of alternating current, given by X_L = omega L.
The opposition offered by a pure capacitor to the flow of alternating current, given by X_C = 1 / (omega C).
The total effective opposition offered by an LCR circuit to the flow of alternating current, measured in ohms.
A condition in an AC circuit where inductive reactance equals capacitive reactance, resulting in minimum impedance and maximum current.
The ratio of true power to apparent power in an AC circuit, mathematically expressed as R / Z.
A dimensionless parameter that characterizes the resonance sharpness and voltage magnification of a resonant circuit.
